outputs.explanation: Panel A is a micrograph (pseudocoloured photoactivation images), not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B consists of line/scatter plots of normalized intensity over time. The individual measured data points (red squares for euchromatin, green dots for heterochromatin) are directly plotted alongside the fitted model curves (solid black lines), both in the main graphs and in the insets, so individual data points underlying the response curves are visible rather than only averaged/fitted summaries.
